name: SCR Group Services
client_reviews: Contractors praise SCR Group Services for their organized workflow and prompt payment processing.

name: Breckenridge Cabin Company
client_reviews: Contractors praise Breckenridge Cabin Company for its flexible scheduling and fair pay rates, but some mention inconsistent workflow and communication issues.

name: RetailData (SAS Retail)
client_reviews: Contractors praise RetailData for consistent and flexible scheduling, but criticize the low hourly pay rate.

name: Pivot Workforce
client_reviews: Contractors praise Pivot Workforce for their reliable payment schedule and variety of field labor opportunities.

name: Bureau Veritas – Building Assessments & Project Management
client_reviews: Contractors praise the firm's consistent workflow and clear communication, but note that pay can be on the lower side for more complex inspections.

name: Congruex
client_reviews: Contractors praise Congruex for its organized project management and timely payment processing, but some report variability in inspection volume and scheduling.

name: CROSSMARK
client_reviews: A flexible option for part-time work or students, though common drawbacks include low starting pay, lack of benefits, and unorganized management communication.

name: Brookfield Global Relocation Services
client_reviews: Brookfield Global Relocation Services is a well-organized company to work with, offering a steady stream of inspection assignments and timely payments

name: Maiden & Associates Architecs/Engineers/ Planners
client_reviews: Contractors generally report fair pay and flexible scheduling with Maiden & Associates.

name: Crawford & Company
client_reviews: Praised for professional coworkers and strong training in specialized insurance claims, but frequently criticized for toxic management and a difficult work-life balance.
